The '''''Gilad Pellaeon''''' was an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] named after the [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] and [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]]. It was [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. It was [[Color/Legends|dark grey]] and larger than most other classes of Star Destroyers (but much smaller than the [[Super-class Star Destroyer|''Super''-class Star Destroyer]]).

==History==
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], it received a diplomatic delegation from the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tiurrg Drey'lye]] of the [[Senate Unification Preparations Committee]] met with Imperial Remnant Head of State [[Jagged Fel]] on the ''Gilad Pellaeon'' prior to the [[Unification Summit]]. It was later abandoned by her crew in [[44 ABY]] during the [[Battle over Exodo II]] after number of direct hits by [[Baradium missile]]s, and was subsequently destroyed.
